text:
Emily Carter: Hey folks — due date ~7 weeks out and I want to get parental leave paperwork organized. Also my partner is pursuing adoption concurrently, so I need to understand e-sign flow, deadlines for benefits/payroll changes, and a short team handoff template. Any quick checklist? @people-ops

Ben Kaplan: Congrats Emily! :tada: Quick bullets: we use DocuSign for signatures; please cc hr@redwood.com. Benefits changes must be submitted within 30 days of the qualifying event. Payroll/top-up adjustments: ideally request 45 days before your leave start to catch the next payroll cycle. FMLA/medical certs: submit within 15 days after you get the FMLA packet. Adoption: we need legal placement docs + final adoption paperwork (upload when available).

Ben Kaplan: Link to the full internal checklist: <https://intranet.redwood.com/people-ops/parental-leave-checklist|internal checklist> — it has step-by-step and state-specific forms.

Tanya (People Ops): Also: we can pre-sign forms now (DocuSign supports anticipated dates) and update dates later if needed. For onsite needs (lactation room, parking for medical appts, short-term equipment): reply to this thread or email people-ops and we’ll book/reserve.

Tanya (People Ops): For coverage — recommend 2-week overlap where possible and an on-call buddy rotation. If you want, we can draft the manager handoff message for you.

Emily Carter: Can I e-sign everything now and tweak dates later? Also planning a phased return (4 days/wk). Will benefits continue during a reduced schedule?

Ben Kaplan: Yes you can e-sign now and confirm dates later. For phased return: please file the "phased return" form (link in the checklist). Benefits generally remain active if you maintain benefits-eligible status — that depends on hours and state law. We'll confirm for your specific case once you submit dates.

Ben Kaplan: Manager handoff template (copy/paste):
```
Hi @<team>,
I'll be on parental leave from START_DATE to END_DATE.
Primary contact while I'm away: NAME (email).
On-call coverage: NAME(s) - see rotation doc: <link>.
Runbooks and outstanding tasks: <link to docs>.
I'll be available for a 2-week overlap for handoff on REQUESTED_DATES.
Thanks — Emily
```

hr-bot: HR request logged: REQ-2026-045. People Ops will follow up within 2 business days with any missing forms or state-specific steps.

Emily Carter: Filing now — thanks so much. I’ll upload adoption docs as they come in and ping if we need specific payroll/top-up adjustments. Really appreciate the help :heart:
